newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's economy grew 2.9 pct in Feb vs Feb '96.
newsitem.headline: Chile's economy grew 2.9 pct in Feb vs Feb '96.

text.p: Chile's economy grew 2.9 percent in February from the same month a year earlier, measured by the IMACEC monthly economic activity index, the central bank said Wednesday.
In the first two months of 1997, accumulated growth was 3.8 percent compared with the same period a year earlier, the central bank added.

The central bank said in a statement the 2.9 percent February growth rate was affected by there being less working days during February 1997 than a year earlier and a high base level for the annual comparison.
It added that the IMACEC's level in February was in line with growth expectations for the first quarter.
